title: Sparkly lantern
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='55%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff7b0'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#ffd75e'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffb31f'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='halo' cx='50%' cy='55%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe98a' stop-opacity='0.45'/>

  <!-- soft halo -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='42' fill='url(#halo)'/>

  <rect x='59' y='40' width='3' height='40' rx='1.5' fill='#c98a2e'/>
  <rect x='38' y='40' width='1.2' height='40' fill='#f0c063'/>
  <rect x='60.8' y='40' width='1.2' height='40' fill='#f0c063'/>

  <!-- base -->
